name: RGB Separation
paragraphs: Separates and offsets the RGB channels in an image. Controls adjust the radius and angle of the channel separation.
Try any of our 16 presets for instant previewing of how RGB Separation can enliven your footage. Find these via the blue Open Dashboard... button or the Choose a Preset... button below it.
As with all other Universe tools, you can modify or create an RGB Separation look and then save it under its own name by pressing the Save Preset... button.
